test_title: PYST 26: SSC MTS - Quantitative Aptitude (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: maths
question: When 8 is added to the numerator of a fraction and 12 is added to its denominator, the fraction becomes (1)/(2). When 2 is subtracted from its numerator and denominator, the fraction becomes (1)/(8). Find the original fraction.
solution: Concept used: Fraction = Numerator/Denominator Calculations: Let the numerator and denominator be x and y respectively When 8 is added to the numerator of a fraction and 12 is added to its denominator, ⇒ (x + 8)/(y + 12) = 1/2 ⇒ 2x + 16 = y + 12 ⇒ 2x + 4 = y ............(i)
